mentions.title: What is TOP assay for when analyzing PFAS?
mentions.description:
TOP-assay gives us information about precursors of PFAS that can transfer to stable PFAS compounds in certain circumstances.

It is possible, for example, to analyze the samples first without the TOP-assay pretreatment to investigate the baseline of the PFAS. After that, TOP-assay can be performed to the same sample material, and after that, the same PFAS compounds are measured. If the concentrations increase, we know that the sample includes precursors of PFAS.
